abstract: Axial computed tomography, as well as direct sagittal computed tomography in some cases, was used to evaluate five cases of sacrococcygeal tumors, and the findings are presented. Computed tomography greatly assisted in making a correct preoperative diagnosis and in delineating the extent of the tumors. Direct sagittal scans readily staged these tumors, whereas axial scans revealed extension in the transverse plane, especially for intraspinal extension.
abstract_ja: 仙尾部腫瘍5例について、軸位断のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と、一部症例では直接矢状断CTを用いて評価し、その所見を提示した。CTは正確な術前診断と腫瘍の進展範囲の描出に大きく役立った。直接矢状断像により腫瘍の病期分類が容易に行えた一方、軸位断像では横断面での進展、特に脊柱管内進展が明らかになった。
